stories.title: Duniya Ka Aakhri Mard
stories.tagline: Ek gehra gaddhar. Ek chamakta hua portal. Aur ek duniya jahan ladka sirf ek purani kahani hai.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — ek aam ladka jiski zindagi ek raat ek gehre gaddhar mein girti hui badal gayi. Andhere mein ek chamakta hua purana darwaaza mila, aur uske paar thi Vaelthara — kingdoms, monsters, magic aur saat shaktishaali mahaaraniyon ki duniya. Par sabse ajeeb baat: is duniya mein ladke exist hi nahi karte. Tum duniya ka aakhri mard ho — ek zinda raaz. Kaun tumhare saath khadi hogi, kaun tumhe control karna chahegi, aur tum khud kya banoge — ye kissto tum khud likhoge. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — purani duniya ka aam young ladka, ab Vaelthara ka sabse anokha aur aakhri mard
stories.setting: Vaelthara — saat mahashaktiyon ki fantasy duniya: sunehri samrajya, demon citadel, mage ka Spire, dragon parvat, beast-kin ke jungle-rajya, pardaon ki sheher, aur beech mein monster-bhara Ghor

stories.title: The Goddess Who Chose Me
stories.tagline: Ek devi jo sab kuch pa sakti hai... usne ek aam ladke ko chuna. Kyun?
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — ek simple sa ladka, simple si zindagi. Phir ek baarish wali shaam Aria tumhare bus stop par aati hai aur keh deti hai: 'Main tumhare saath rahungi.' Woh kaun hai, ye baad mein pata chalta hai — hazaaron saal purani devi jise poori chhupi hui divine duniya darti hai. Par tumhare saamne woh bas ek ladki ban jaati hai jo maggi banana seekhna chahti hai. Sawaal ek hi hai: usne tumhe kyun chuna? Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — har arc ke baad ek naya darwaaza khulta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka, koi power nahi, chhupi hui divine duniya ke baare mein kuch nahi jaanta
stories.setting: Aaj ka Mumbai — aur uske saath-saath chalti ek chhupi hui divine duniya (Antarlok) jo aam insaan nahi dekh sakte

stories.title: My Girlfriend Is the Last God
stories.tagline: Tumhe lagta tha tum use bacha rahe ho. Sach ulta tha — hamesha se.
stories.description: Duniya maanti hai ki devta sadiyon pehle gayab ho gaye. Tum {{playerName}} ho, aur tumhari girlfriend Elara bas thodi 'zyada capable' hai — woh andhere mein bhi raasta jaanti hai, kutte usse darte hain, aur ek baar ek girta hua hoarding uske paas aake ruk gaya tha. Phir ajeeb hadse shuru hote hain. Aur dheere-dheere tumhe pata chalta hai: Elara purane dev-yudh ki aakhri bachi hui devi hai, aur purane dushman use dhoondh rahe hain. Yeh kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — har raaz ek naya darwaaza kholta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka, Elara ka boyfriend, jise lagta hai woh Elara ko protect kar raha hai
stories.setting: Aaj ka Pune — aur uske neeche dabi ek duniya jo maanti hai ki devta mar chuke hain

stories.title: She Can Rewrite Reality
stories.tagline: Photo badal gayi. Café kabhi tha hi nahi. Aur tumhari girlfriend muskura rahi hai.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho. Tumhari girlfriend Lyra bilkul normal hai — jab tak ek din woh café gayab nahi ho jaata jahan tum dono pehli baar mile the. Sirf gayab nahi: 'kabhi tha hi nahi'. Phir ek photo badalti hai. Phir tumhara dost ek baat alag yaad karta hai. Dheere-dheere tum samajhte ho — Lyra reality ko rewrite kar sakti hai. Yaadein, cheezein, ghatnayein, sab. Sawaal ye nahi ki woh kar sakti hai. Sawaal ye hai: kitni baar kar chuki hai? Aur ek cheez jo woh rewrite nahi kar paati — tumhari feelings. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka jo apne aas-paas chhoti-chhoti galat cheezein notice karne lagta hai
stories.setting: Aaj ka Bengaluru — jo bilkul normal dikhta hai, aur isiliye har inconsistency aur zyada darawni hai

stories.title: My Girlfriend Has Lived 1,000 Lives
stories.tagline: Woh tumhe pehle se jaanti hai. Har baar. Is baar woh kuch alag try kar rahi hai.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho, aur tum Elena se pehli baar mile ho — par woh tumhe aise dekhti hai jaise sadiyon se jaanti ho. Woh tumhari aadatein jaanti hai. Woh cheezein hone se pehle react karti hai. Woh kabhi batati nahi kyun. Sach: Elena ne hazaaron timelines jeeyi hain, aur har ek mein woh tumhe dhoondhti hai. Har baar sab alag hota hai. Is baar usne tay kiya hai ki woh tumhe sab nahi batayegi — kyunki woh jaanna chahti hai ki kya ye zindagi aakhirkaar alag ho sakti hai. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — har loop ek naya darwaaza hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka jise pichli kisi timeline ki koi yaad nahi
stories.setting: Aaj ka Jaipur — ek shehar jismein timelines repeat hoti hain aur reality reset ho sakti hai, aur sirf ek ladki ko ye yaad rehta hai

stories.title: The Empress and Her Fool
stories.tagline: Sab sochte hain tum ek bekaar naukar ho. Samragyi jaanti hai tum bhavishya ho.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Suryagarh ke mahal ka sabse neeche darje ka sevak, jiske paas jaadu ke naam par ek diya jalaane bhar ki shakti hai. Phir ek din jawan Samragyi Seraphina — rajya ki sabse shaktishaali jaadugarni — tumhe apna niji sevak chun leti hai. Poora mahal hansta hai. Sardar shak karte hain. Sach koi nahi jaanta: ek prachin bhavishyavani tumhe duniya ke bhavishya se jodti hai, aur Seraphina tumhe isliye paas rakhti hai. Sab sochte hain tumhe bachaane ki zaroorat hai. Asal mein woh tumhe har pal bacha rahi hai. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — mahal se academy, academy se khandahar, khandahar se prachin sach tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — mahal ka nichle darje ka sevak, lagbhag shunya jaadu, ab Samragyi ka niji sevak
stories.setting: Suryagarh — ek vishaal jaadui samrajya: mahal, sardar gharane, jaadui academy, prachin sabhyataon ke khandahar, aur padosi rajya jo hamesha taak mein hain

stories.title: The Dragon Girl Next Door
stories.tagline: Woh pahaad tod sakti hai. Par toaster? Toaster se woh haar gayi.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho, aur tumhare bagal wale flat mein ek nayi ladki shift hui hai — Rhea. Woh energetic hai, curious hai, ziddi hai, aur usne pehle hi din toaster jala diya, doodh wale se ladai ki, aur chhat se 'gir' ke bina khoronch ke uth gayi. Sach: Rhea ek prachin dragon hai jo insaano ke beech rehna seekh rahi hai. Woh kisi bhi supernatural cheez ko haath se hara sakti hai — par auto-wale se bhaav-taav nahi kar paati. Tum uske 'insaaniyat ke guide' ban jaate ho. Aur phir doosre dragons ko pata chalta hai woh kahan hai. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — mohalle se dragon clans, clans se prachin rajneeti tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — aam ladka, jise dragons ke baare mein kuch nahi pata, aur ab ek dragon ka 'insaaniyat guide' hai
stories.setting: Aaj ka Indore — ek shaant si housing society, jahan prachin dragons chupke se insaano ke beech rehte hain (aur ek ne abhi-abhi flat 302 kiraye par liya hai)

stories.title: The Queen Beneath the Moon
stories.tagline: Poore rajya use dhoondh rahe hain. Woh tumhare gaon ki jhopdi mein chai pee rahi hai.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Chandanpur naam ke chhote se gaon ka aam ladka. Ek raat tumhe nadi kinare ek ghayal aurat milti hai — chaandi jaise baal, phata hua neela lubaada. Tum use apni jhopdi mein panaah dete ho, bina jaane ki woh kaun hai. Sach: woh Selene hai — amar Chandra Rani, jisse poore rajya darte hain, aur jiski khoi hui sena use wapas laane ke liye har gaon chhaan rahi hai. Selene wapas nahi jaana chahti. Uski sabse badi ladai dushmanon se nahi hai — khud se hai: woh kaunsi zindagi jeena chahti hai? Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — gaon se rajya, rajya se bhoole hue devtaon tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Chandanpur gaon ka aam ladka, jisne ek ghayal ajnabi ko panaah di
stories.setting: Ek fantasy duniya — rajya, prachin jaadu, supernatural praani aur bhoole hue devta. Shuruaat: Chandanpur naam ka chhota gaon, nadi kinare, poornima ki raat

stories.title: The Witch Who Loves a Human
stories.tagline: Insaan aur daayan peedhiyon se dushman hain. Phir usne tumhe chun liya.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Seemant naam ke sarhadi kasbe ka aam ladka, jahan insaan is taraf rehte hain aur daayanein us taraf. Ek shaam jungle ke kinare tumhe ek ladki milti hai — Mira. Woh mazaakiya hai, confident hai, aur uski aankhon mein kuch aisa hai jo tumne kabhi nahi dekha. Tum use nahi jaante. Woh tumhe janne lagti hai. Sach: Mira duniya ki sabse shaktishaali daayanon mein se ek hai — 'Legend' — aur usne apni pehchaan tumse chhupayi hai. Jab jaadui duniya ko pata chalta hai ki unki sabse badi daayan ne ek aam insaan ko chuna hai, sab kuch khatre mein aa jaata hai. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — chhupe rishte se daayan-sabha, sabha se dushmani ki asli jad tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Seemant kasbe ka aam insaan, koi jaadu nahi, jise ek daayan ne bina bataye chun liya
stories.setting: Ek jaadui duniya jo do hisson mein bati hai — insaano ka desh aur daayanon ka Vanraj — aur beech mein Seemant, ek sarhadi kasba jahan dono duniyaon ki hawa milti hai

stories.title: The Girl Who Commands the Sun
stories.tagline: Woh Sooraj ki Devi hai. Use bas ek aam ladki banna hai. Aur tumhe use sikhana hai — bus kaise pakadte hain.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Pune mein ek chhoti si travel agency mein kaam karne wala aam ladka. Ek subah tumhare office ke bahar ek ladki khadi hai jo bus stop dekh kar confuse hai, jiske aas-paas ki hawa thodi zyada garam hai, aur jo tumse poochhti hai — 'ye chhutti kya hoti hai?' Uska naam Solara hai. Woh Sooraj ki Devi hai — literally. Sooraj uske mood ke saath uthta hai, dhalta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi thoda zyada chamakta hai. Use ek aam zindagi chahiye. Tumhe use sikhana hai. Aur upar, swarg mein, log bahut naraaz hain. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — pehli chai se lekar swarg ki rajneeti tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Pune ki chhoti travel agency ka aam ladka, jise Sooraj ki Devi ne 'aam zindagi' ka guide bana liya
stories.setting: Pune — aam sheher, aam bus, aam chai — aur upar ek swarg jo dheere-dheere is 'aam' se pareshan ho raha hai

stories.title: When the Goddess Becomes Human
stories.tagline: Usne sab kuch chhod diya — ek insaan banne ke liye. Woh nahi batati kyun. Tum wahi ho jise use batana chahiye.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Rishikesh mein ek chhoti si library chalane wala aam ladka. Ek din ek ladki library mein aati hai jo har kitaab ko aise chhooti hai jaise pehli baar kuch chhoo rahi ho. Uska naam Aelia hai. Woh naya-naya insaan hai — literally. Kabhi woh poori srishti ki sabse badi divine hasti thi. Usne woh sab chhod diya — nashwar banne ke liye — aur woh kisi ko nahi batati kyun. Uski shakti ab bhi kabhi-kabhi nikalti hai — jab woh bhavuk hoti hai. Aur duniya — dono duniyaein — use dhoondh rahi hain. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — pehli baarish mehsoos karne se lekar uske chhodne ki asli wajah tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Rishikesh ki chhoti library ka aam ladka, jise ek purv-devi ne 'insaan hona' seekhne ke liye chuna
stories.setting: Rishikesh — Ganga, pahaad, ek purani library — aur uske peeche ek divine duniya jo apni sabse badi hasti ko kho chuki hai aur use dhoondh rahi hai

stories.title: Midnight Local
stories.tagline: Last train. Strange co-passengers. Ek raaz jo platform 4 pe chhupa hai.
stories.description: Churchgate se chali aakhri local... jo kabhi Dadar pahunchi hi nahi. Andheri tunnel mein train rukti hai, lights flicker hoti hain, aur tumhare dabbe mein sirf 4 log hain — jismein se ek kuch chhupa raha hai. Doston ke saath milke raaz solve karo, ya loop mein fans jao.
stories.userRole: First-year college student, late-night local traveller
stories.setting: Mumbai suburban railway, 11:47 PM, monsoon season

stories.title: Hawa-Band Dhaba
stories.tagline: 3 AM. Kohra. Ek dhaba jo map par nahi dikhta — aur teen kursiyan jo hamesha bhari rehti hain.
stories.description: 3 AM, ghana kohra, aur gaadi ka engine band. Highway ke kinare ek dhaba hai jiska naam map par nahi hai — 'Hawa-Band Dhaba'. Andar light jal rahi hai, chai garam hai, aur teesra mehmaan tumhare liye jagah chhodkar baitha hai. Yahan khana free hai. Par 'hisaab' kisi na kisi din toh chukana padta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — raat ko expressway par akela driver, jo galti se ruk gaya
stories.setting: Mumbai–Pune Expressway ka ek sunsaan mod, kohra, 3:12 AM

stories.title: Crush on the Roof
stories.tagline: Chhat se chitthi udhti hai, credit kisi aur ko milta hai — aur fest cancel hone mein 48 ghante hain.
stories.description: Class 12, last year, aur ek chitthi jo galat aadmi ke naam se post ho gayi. Tum {{playerName}} ho — roof par baithkar likhi gayi anonymous chitthiyen tumhare haath se nikalti hain, par college ka shor Neel ke naam se macha hai. Ab sawaal ye nahi ki chitthi kaunsi acchi thi — sawaal ye hai ki tum sach kab bologe.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Class 12 ka quiet ladka, asli "Chitthi No. 9"
stories.setting: Pune ka ek purana arts college, annual fest se 48 ghante pehle

stories.title: Pani @ 72
stories.tagline: 72 ghante ki baarish. Ek behen chhat par, ek Dadi neeche, aur ek naksha jo poore mohalle ka paani rok sakta hai.
stories.description: 72 ghante ki baarish. Mumbai ka paani kamar se upar aa gaya hai. Tumhari chhoti behen school ki chhat par hai, Dadi ground floor par akeli, aur Ma Navi Mumbai mein phansi hai. Tumhare haath mein Dadi ka 40 saal purana nallah naksha hai — aur ek corporate builder ka woh contract jisne poora naksha mitwa diya. 72 ghante. Ek family. Do raaste: bachao, ya sach nikaalo.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 19, engineering ka student, cycle aur rassi ka hero
stories.setting: Mumbai, July — record 72-ghante ki baarish, paani 5 foot

stories.title: Gully Final
stories.tagline: Final. 6 balls. 12 runs. Aur ek envelope jismein 50 hazaar hain — "last over mat daalo".
stories.description: Ramnagar Maidan Cup. Final. 200 run ka target nahi — 1 envelope ka target hai. Tum {{playerName}} ho, gali ke Sher ke 8 number par, aur aaj subah builder ke bete ne tumhare haath mein 50 hazaar rakh diye: 'last over mat daalo.' Coach Ramakaka kehte hain 'over kar de', Zoya kehti hai 'nahi kar de', aur Chintu scoreboard par sab likh raha hai — bhoolta bhi nahi. Ab 6 balls hain.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 17, Gali ke Sher ka slow left-arm all-rounder
stories.setting: Kurla ka Ramnagar maidan, Cup final, shaam 4:30 se andhere tak

stories.title: Night Courier
stories.tagline: Raat 2:47. 18,000 ka "Black Lifafa". Room 304 ka darwaza andar se band hai.
stories.description: Raat 2:11. Tumhare rider app par ek order aata hai: 'Black Lifafa — handle with care, no photo, no signature.' 18,000 rupaye ek delivery ke. Par lifafa halka hai, hotel ka room 304 andar se band hai, aur corridor mein ek aurat do baar guzar chuki hai — dono baar bina awaaz ke. Tumhare paas teen raaste hain: protocol follow karo, lifafa kholo, ya 100 dial karo. Ek baat yaad rakhna: app ka algorithm tumhara dost nahi hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 26, raat-shift delivery rider, 4.9 rating wala top partner
stories.setting: Pune, 2:11 AM se 5:40 AM — barish, sunsaan road, aur ek doobta heritage hotel

stories.title: Café Queen Myra
stories.tagline: Innocent smile, simple outfit... aur shehar ki sabse dangerous Mafia Queen.
stories.description: Shaam ki halki baarish ke baad ek cozy café. Waiter ki ek chhoti si galti se tumhari coffee Myra ke table par pahunch jaati hai — aur tum us ladki ke saamne baith ho jiska naam shehar dheere bolta hai. Myra jaanna chahti hai ki tum kitna jaante ho. Naam bologe? Lifafa khologe? Ya black car mein baitho ge?
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — café ka regular customer, jo galti se ek badi duniya ke beech aa gaya
stories.setting: Mumbai ka ek cozy café, shaam ki halki baarish ke baad; bahar ek black car wait kar rahi hai

stories.title: Aakhri Yodha
stories.tagline: Agni Mani ko Surya Mandir tak pahunchana hai. Senapati Rudra tumhe rokne aayega.
stories.description: Aryavarta ka aakhri royal guard tumhare gaon mein dum todta hai — aur jaate-jaate tumhe de jaata hai Agni Mani, ek aisa ratna jo poori sena ko hara sakta hai. Ab ek bhaagti hui 'naukarani' (jo woh hai nahi), ek baatuni kauwa, aur ek khunkhaar Senapati tumhare safar ka hissa hain.
stories.userRole: Village teen chosen as the Mani-bearer
stories.setting: Fantasy kingdom of Aryavarta — forests, forts and temples

stories.title: Chai, Dreams & Backbenchers
stories.tagline: College fest, ek flop natak, aur tapri wali strategy meetings.
stories.description: Naya college, naye dost, aur dramatics club ka audition — jismein tum galti se select ho gaye. Ab 10 din mein fest ka play taiyaar karna hai, lead actor nakchadha hai, script adhoori hai, aur Bablu ki tapri par har shaam 'emergency meeting' hoti hai. Full comedy, full feels.
stories.userRole: First-year student, accidental theatre club member
stories.setting: A lively Pune arts college during annual fest season

stories.title: Starship Vikrant
stories.tagline: Cadet se hero tak ka safar — first contact protocol activated.
stories.description: Year 2187. Tum INS Vikrant par sabse young cadet ho. Ek routine patrol ke dauraan ship ko milta hai ek signal — jo insaanon ka bheja hua NAHI hai. Captain Rao ke orders, Zoya ki jugaad engineering, aur Sphatik aliens ke saath first contact... galaxy ki kismat tumhare faislon par hai.
stories.userRole: Youngest cadet aboard the starship INS Vikrant
stories.setting: Deep space, aboard INS Vikrant, year 2187

stories.title: Neo Delhi 2099
stories.tagline: Yaadein yahan currency hain. Aur tum ek memory courier ho.
stories.description: Samudra ne Connaught Place ko nigal liya hai, aur Aakash Dynamics logon ki yaadein khareed-bech raha hai. Tum ek memory courier ho — clients ki yaadon ka dabba ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunchate ho, bina khole. Aaj ka package khaas hai: ismein tumhari APNI chori hui yaad ho sakti hai. Lalach, sach, ya survival — kya chunoge?
stories.userRole: Memory courier in flooded Neo Delhi
stories.setting: Flooded cyberpunk Delhi, year 2099

stories.title: Pahaadon Wali Haveli
stories.tagline: Viraasat mein mili ek haveli... aur usmein rehne wali 'Baai'.
stories.description: Uttarakhand ke sunsaan pahaadon mein tumhe virasat mein mili hai ek 150 saal purani haveli — aur gaon wale kehte hain wahan 'Baai' rehti hai. Caretaker Bisht kuch chhupa raha hai, purani diary mein aadhe panne phate hain, aur har raat 2:22 par ghanti bajti hai. Andar jaane ki himmat hai?
stories.userRole: City heir visiting an inherited hill haveli
stories.setting: A 150-year-old haveli in the Uttarakhand hills

stories.title: Bhabi Ka Ladla Devar
stories.tagline: Ghar ki deewaron mein dabi khamoshi, apnapan aur ek patni ki jalan.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — tumhari shaadi Tanvi se hui hai. Kuch samay pehle tumhare bade bhai Rajesh ek hadse mein guzar gaye, aur unki patni Sunaina bhabhi vidhwa ho gayi. Tum hamesha se apni bhabhi ke kareeb rahe ho, aur woh tumhe parivar ke devar ki tarah behad sneh aur izzat deti hain. Lekin Tanvi ko lagta hai ki is ghar mein uska haq bant raha hai. Yeh kahani parivar, vishwas, maryada aur rishton ke beech ke uljhan ki hai — jahan har faisla ghar bana sakta hai ya tod sakta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — chhota beta aur pati, jo apni patni Tanvi ke shaq aur apni vidhwa bhabhi Sunaina ke parivarik aadar ke beech santulan bana raha hai
stories.setting: Delhi ka ek aam sanyukt parivar ka ghar — Sharma Niwas, drawing room, kitchen, aur terrace

stories.title: Goddess of Underworld Loves Me
stories.tagline: Olympus ke jashn mein sab devta jisse darte hain... woh raat ki devi tum par muskurayi.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — bachpan se ek controlling maa ke pehre mein pale-badhe. Pehli baar azaad hokar tum Olympus ke chamak-dhamak wale dev-lok mein kadam rakhte ho. Yahan devtaon ki siyasat, taakat ka dikhava aur lavish parties hain. Bheed se ghabra kar tum ek andhere balcony par aate ho, jahan kaali poshak mein ek behad khoobsurat aur pur-asraar aurat akeli khadi hai — Nyx, raat aur Underworld ki aadi devi. Woh dheere se poochti hai: "Tum mujhe nahi jaante, do you?" Aur isi sawaal se shuru hoti hai tumhari aisi dastaan jo swarg aur paatal dono ki kismat badal sakti hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek naya insaani aagantuk jo Olympus ki dev-siyasat mein anjaane mein Nyx ka dhyan kheench leta hai
stories.setting: Mount Olympus ke marble palaces, astral gardens aur Underworld ke sitaron bhare andhere mahal

stories.title: The Ghost Behind the Quiet Boy
stories.tagline: Library ka sabse shareef ladka... dark web ka beraham badshah.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho (alias Vihaan) — Imperial College ki library ke aakhri kone mein moti kitabon ke peeche chhupa ek seedha-saadha, masoom student. Duniya samajhti hai ki tumhein kisi se baat karna nahi aata. Lekin tumhari doosri pehchaan hai "The Ghost" — Dark Web ka sabse khaufnaak aur azeem hacker jiske ek code se sarkarein hil jaati hain. Yeh sach sirf teen log jaante hain: tumhari sauteli maa Madhu, behen Sia, aur dost Dev. Sab kuch theek chal raha tha, jab tak Anaya Sharma library ki us table par aakar nahi baithi. Uski tez nazar tumhare shareef chehre ke peeche chhupe shaitaan ko bhaampne lagi hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} (alias Vihaan) — ek masoom aur shant student jo secret mein Dark Web ka badshah The Ghost hai
stories.setting: Imperial University campus, central library, underground server den, aur tech labs

stories.title: Girlfriends Unlimited
stories.tagline: Ek anokha app upgrade, ek ₹4,200 crore ki CEO, aur Mumbai ka sabse bada game.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — 9-to-5 ki ghissi-pitti naukri, sar par lakhon ka karz aur dating apps par continuous rejections. Ek aadhi raat ko tumhare saste phone par notification chamakta hai: "App updated to UnHinge Pro."
